children: -- Atlantis Casino Resort Spa is proud to announce that five of its restaurants have earned the 2026 Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice Award, recognizing them among the top 10% of restaurants worldwide.
Oyster & Sushi Bar on the Sky Terrace
The five honorees represent the breadth of Atlantis’ culinary offerings, spanning fine dining, fresh seafood and sushi, Asian cuisine, classic deli favorites, and casual dining.

“We are incredibly proud to see five of our restaurants recognized by Tripadvisor travelers," said Chira Pagidi, Corporate Director of Food and Beverage. “This recognition reflects the passion and dedication of our chefs, managers and service teams, who consistently strive to deliver exceptional food, service, and memorable dining experiences for our guests. From fine dining and fresh seafood to casual favorites, we are proud to offer memorable culinary experiences that continue to earn the trust and appreciation of visitors from around the world. Having five distinct restaurants recognized is especially meaningful, as it reflects the strength and diversity of our culinary program throughout the resort.”

The Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice Awards recognize businesses that consistently earn excellent reviews from travelers around the world and rank among the top-rated hospitality destinations on the platform. They are based entirely on authentic guest feedback collected on Tripadvisor over a 12-month period, making the recognition a meaningful reflection of customer satisfaction and dining excellence.
Atlantis Casino Resort Spa, owned and operated by Monarch Casino & Resort, Inc.

, is an award-winning luxury resort that has consistently ranked as the #1 Reno resort on TripAdvisor, earned top recognition from leading travel and hospitality organizations including U.S. News & World Report and Forbes Travel Guide, and holds the prestigious AAA Four Diamond designation. Located at the base of the Sierra Nevada, Atlantis is close to Lake Tahoe, breathtaking hiking trails, world-class skiing and premier golf courses. The property is known for its luxurious accommodations, award-winning dining experiences including Reno's only Forbes Four-Star restaurant and Forbes Four-Star spa, captivating bars and lounges, and casino-wide action.
